lines.speaker: Phong
lines.text: Good morning, Hoa. We'd like to go through a few audit findings from this quarter.

lines.speaker: Hoa
lines.text: Good morning. Sure, please go ahead.

lines.speaker: Phong
lines.text: We ran a spot check on your March invoices and found a documentation gap for two of them.

lines.speaker: Hoa
lines.text: I see. Those might be the vendor invoices we processed manually during the system outage.

lines.speaker: Phong
lines.text: That's possible. Can you send the supporting paperwork by Friday?

lines.speaker: Hoa
lines.text: Yes, I'll ask the team to send it over today.

lines.speaker: Phong
lines.text: We also noticed a control weakness in how expense approvals are tracked.

lines.speaker: Hoa
lines.text: Understood. What corrective action would you recommend?

lines.speaker: Phong
lines.text: Adding a second approver above a certain materiality threshold would help.

lines.speaker: Hoa
lines.text: That makes sense. We'll remediate that within the next two weeks.

lines.speaker: Phong
lines.text: Good. I'll raise a red flag on it in my notes, but it's an easy fix.

lines.speaker: Hoa
lines.text: Thanks — will this go to the audit committee, or just stay in your working notes?
